highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback on the Skia m152 engine.
highlights_body: This release also hardens pixel and stream lifetimes, improves allocation-sensitive APIs, and expands supported native package coverage.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through Chrome m152 servicing
bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates later stability and use-after-free fixes from upstream servicing.
Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling applications to target the newer GPU architecture.
SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support for non-blocking pixel retrieval.
Restores production packaging for the Vulkan Silk.NET integration so applications can consume its GPU bindings.
Keeps source objects alive while extracting pixmap subsets and resolving SKRegion spans, preventing native use-after-free failures.

bullets.lead: Raster image creation no longer leaks failed pixel buffers
bullets.detail: Releases CoTaskMem pixel buffers when SKImage.Create cannot create a raster image.
Disposes the non-memory-backed SKStreamAsset used when creating HarfBuzz blobs.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support uses FreeType
bullets.detail: Bundles FreeType support for fonts on Nano Server, improving text rendering on that Windows deployment target.
Publishes native symbols with Apple packages to improve crash-symbolication support.
Reduces avoidable copying, boxing, string allocation, reflection work, and map resizing in encoding, tags, runtime effects, and handle registration.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed Nano Server font support
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the m152 engine update, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added native symbols, restored Vulkan Silk.NET packaging, and completed release validation.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzzSharp stream ownership and shaping performance, and updates the package documentation.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, and asynchronous pixel readback.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds native package coverage and fixes lifetime issues in pixel and region APIs.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 completes validation for the m152 release line.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It adds Apple native symbol packages and restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback on Skia m152.
v4.152.0.body: The stable release includes upstream renderer servicing and managed lifetime and allocation improvements.
